annotations.text:
Bento — traveller-facing screens, direction 2.

The app is a bento box: lacquer-dark frames, compartment tiles in food colours (salmon, tamago, edamame, umeboshi) on warm rice white. Tiles settle into place on load; bars and rings fill; badges pop.

Bricolage Grotesque headlines · DM Sans body · DM Mono data · Zen Maru Gothic for Japanese.

Static mockups. Same real Kansai–Sanyo trip and owner profile as before.

Day view: the lacquer box holds one main compartment (the timeline, tile height ∝ minutes) and three side compartments — budget ring, Bento Man's note, and what was considered and left out. Tile colour = category: salmon shrine, green temple garden, blue indoors, yellow food.
Route: tile area follows nights — Kyoto is the biggest compartment because it gets four. Nara is a sliver (day trip), Himeji is white (en route, not a stay).
